newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells DM 0.9 mln shares in two firms.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells DM 0.9 mln shares in two firms.

text.p: Croatia's state privatisation agency, the Croatian Privatisation Fund, sold 936,300 German marks worth of shares in two firms for public debt bonds.
At a first auction this autumn for blocked hard currency savings bonds, which entitle buyers to a discount of up to 30 percent, the fund sold:
* 1,647 shares in Varazdin-based firm Universal d.d. at 500 marks each to Varazdinska Banka acting as broker and
* 1,128 shares in aluminium packaging maker Tvornica Limene Ambalaze from Vela Luka at 100 marks a share to private brokerage Fintrade.

After the summer break, the agency is also to restart its cash auctions each Thursday for minority stakes in mostly privatised Croatian firms, some of them at half price. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
